questions.text: The first electronic computer was designed and built at the University of Pennsylvania based on ___ technology.
questions.explanation: The first electronic computer was built using vacuum tube technology.

questions.text: First generation computers were slow and large, and their main memory was made up of ___.
questions.explanation: First generation main memory was made of vacuum tubes.

questions.text: Second generation computers replaced vacuum tubes with ___.
questions.explanation: Transistors replaced vacuum tubes in the second generation.

questions.text: Third generation computers used ___ instead of transistorized circuitry.
questions.explanation: Integrated circuits replaced transistors in the third generation.

questions.text: Fourth generation computers were based on the ___.
questions.explanation: The microprocessor powered fourth generation computers.

questions.text: Fifth generation computers are based on ___.
questions.explanation: Fifth generation computers are based on artificial intelligence.

questions.text: Which generation of computers used punched cards for input and magnetic tapes for output?
questions.explanation: First generation computers used punched cards and magnetic tapes.

questions.text: High-level languages such as FORTRAN and COBOL were first used in the ___ generation.
questions.explanation: High-level languages such as FORTRAN and COBOL appeared in the second generation.

questions.text: A computer accepts data as input and processes it according to a prearranged sequence of instructions called a ___.
questions.explanation: The instructions a computer follows are called a program.

questions.text: Raw facts and figures that on their own have no meaning are called ___.
questions.explanation: Data are raw facts and figures that have no meaning by themselves.

questions.text: Data that has been processed within a context to give it meaning is called ___.
questions.explanation: Processed data with meaning is information.

questions.text: Which of the following is a characteristic of a computer system?
questions.explanation: Speed is one of the common characteristics of a computer system.

questions.text: The ability of a computer to perform different types of work is known as ___.
questions.explanation: Versatility lets one computer perform many different types of work.

questions.text: Computers have no ___ of their own.
questions.explanation: Computers do not possess IQ of their own.

questions.text: The fastest and most powerful type of computer is the ___.
questions.explanation: Supercomputers are the fastest and most powerful computers.

questions.text: The chief difference between a supercomputer and a mainframe is that a supercomputer channels all its power into executing ___ as fast as possible.
questions.explanation: A supercomputer focuses its power on executing a few programs as fast as possible.

questions.text: Which computer is a large multi-user system that supports hundreds or thousands of users simultaneously?
questions.explanation: Mainframes support hundreds or thousands of users at the same time.

questions.text: IBM PC, PS/2 and Apple Macintosh are examples of ___.
questions.explanation: IBM PC, PS/2 and Apple Macintosh are examples of microcomputers.

questions.text: A microcomputer uses a ___ as its central processing unit.
questions.explanation: Microcomputers use a microprocessor as their central processing unit.

questions.text: Which type of computer works on numerical data represented by a physical quantity that varies continuously, such as temperature?
questions.explanation: Analog computers measure continuously varying physical quantities.

questions.text: Digital computers represent data in ___.
questions.explanation: Digital computers represent data in binary form using 0s and 1s.

questions.text: Which type of computer combines the features of both analog and digital computers?
questions.explanation: Hybrid computers combine both analog and digital features.

questions.text: A computer designed to perform one specific task and whose program is permanently stored is a ___.
questions.explanation: Special purpose computers perform one specific task.

questions.text: Software is a collection of related ___ chained together in function and operation.
questions.explanation: Software is a collection of related programs.

questions.text: Computer software is broadly categorized into system software and ___ software.
questions.explanation: The two main categories are system software and application software.

questions.text: Software that instructs the computer to perform the tasks necessary to get a job done is ___.
questions.explanation: Application software helps the computer get jobs done.

questions.text: Which type of software controls the performance and function of the computer system?
questions.explanation: System software controls the performance and functions of the computer.

questions.text: An operating system acts as an interface between the user and the ___.
questions.explanation: The operating system is the interface between the user and the hardware.

questions.text: The process of starting or restarting a computer is called ___.
questions.explanation: Starting or restarting a computer is called booting.

questions.text: GUI stands for ___.
questions.explanation: GUI is Graphical User Interface.

questions.text: With a graphical user interface, the user interacts with ___.
questions.explanation: A GUI allows interaction through menus and visual images.

questions.text: Which type of interface requires a user to type instructions on the keyboard?
questions.explanation: A command-line interface requires the user to type commands.

questions.text: Memory management optimizes the use of ___.
questions.explanation: Memory management optimizes the use of RAM.

questions.text: Virtual memory is a portion of a storage medium functioning as additional ___.
questions.explanation: Virtual memory serves as additional RAM.

questions.text: A program that assesses and reports information about various computer resources and devices is a ___.
questions.explanation: A performance monitor reports on computer resources and devices.

questions.text: A password is a private combination of ___ associated with the user name.
questions.explanation: A password is a private combination of characters.

questions.text: Which operating system organizes and coordinates how multiple users access and share resources on a network?
questions.explanation: A server operating system coordinates resource sharing on a network.

questions.text: Windows 7 and Mac OS X are examples of ___ operating systems.
questions.explanation: Windows 7 and Mac OS X are stand-alone operating systems.

questions.text: An embedded operating system resides on a ___ chip on a mobile device.
questions.explanation: Embedded operating systems reside on ROM chips.

questions.text: A utility program is a type of system software that allows a user to perform ___ tasks.
questions.explanation: Utility programs allow users to perform maintenance-type tasks.

questions.text: Which utility performs functions such as copying, renaming, deleting and moving files?
questions.explanation: A file manager handles file organization tasks.

questions.text: Which utility searches for and removes unnecessary files from a hard disk?
questions.explanation: Disk cleanup removes unnecessary files from a hard disk.

questions.text: A disk defragmenter ___.
options: Reorganizes files and unused space for faster access
questions.explanation: Defragmenting reorganizes files so data is accessed more quickly.

questions.text: Which utility allows users to copy files to another storage medium?
questions.explanation: A backup utility copies files to another storage medium.

questions.text: A file compression utility ___.
questions.explanation: File compression shrinks the size of files.

questions.text: Compressed files are sometimes called ___ files.
questions.explanation: Compressed files are sometimes called zipped files.

questions.text: A screen saver causes the screen to show a moving image or blank screen if ___.
options: No activity occurs for a specified time
questions.explanation: Screen savers appear after a specified period of inactivity.

questions.text: Which utility removes a program as well as its associated entries in the system files?
questions.explanation: An uninstaller removes a program and its system file entries.

questions.text: A personal firewall detects and protects a personal computer from ___.
questions.explanation: A personal firewall blocks unauthorized intrusions.

questions.text: Word processing software allows users to ___.
questions.explanation: Word processing software creates and manipulates documents.

questions.text: Spreadsheet software allows users to organize data in ___.
questions.explanation: Spreadsheets organize data in rows and columns.

questions.text: In a spreadsheet, a predefined formula that performs common calculations is called a ___.
questions.explanation: A function is a predefined formula for common calculations.

questions.text: Which application software allows users to create, access and manage a database?
questions.explanation: Database software allows users to manage a database.

questions.text: Presentation software allows users to create ___.
questions.explanation: Presentation software creates visual aids for presentations.

questions.text: A software suite is ___.
options: A collection of individual programs available together as a unit
questions.explanation: A software suite is a collection of programs sold together as a unit.

questions.text: Batch operating systems were designed to control ___ computers.
questions.explanation: Batch operating systems were designed to control mainframe computers.

questions.text: In a time-sharing system, each job is allocated a ___ to use a resource.
questions.explanation: Time-sharing allocates each job a portion of time to use a resource.

questions.text: An operating system that supports two or more processors running programs at the same time is called a ___ operating system.
questions.explanation: A multiprocessing operating system supports two or more processors.

questions.text: In distributed systems, jobs are shared between ___.
options: Computers that may be thousands of miles apart
questions.explanation: Distributed systems share jobs between computers that may be far apart.

questions.text: Which system software defines, creates and maintains a database?
questions.explanation: A DBMS defines, creates and maintains databases.

questions.text: SQL stands for ___.
questions.explanation: SQL is Structured Query Language.

questions.text: The activity of setting up software to work with the computer, printer and other hardware is called ___.
questions.explanation: Installation sets up software to work with computer hardware.

questions.text: Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint are examples of ___.
questions.explanation: Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint are application software.
